home.subtext: Professional football training designed to develop skills, confidence, discipline, and teamwork.
home.aboutTitle: A structured path from first touch to first team.
home.aboutBody: SCORE is dedicated to developing young football players through structured training, professional coaching, teamwork, discipline, and continuous performance development. Every player follows a clear program, tracked by real coaches, visible to real parents.
home.whyTitle: A development system, not just a training slot.
home.why1Body: Licensed coaches with structured, age-appropriate curricula for every stage.
home.why2Body: Individual growth plans tracked evaluation by evaluation, not guesswork.
home.why3Body: First touch, passing, and finishing drilled with real repetition.
home.why4Body: Conditioning built for a growing athlete, not an adult program.
home.why5Body: Small-sided games and match play that reward the team, not the individual.
home.why6Body: Every session and evaluation logged, visible to parents in real time.
home.performanceTitle: Every player gets a real profile — not a guess.
home.performanceBody: Coaches log technical, physical, and mental evaluations after every session. Parents see progress the same way a scout would read it.
home.noNews: No announcements yet. Check back soon.
home.ctaBody: Registration takes a few minutes. Coaches review every application.

programsPage.title: Programs by age group
programsPage.subtitle: Every program follows a structured curriculum built for that stage of a player's development.
programsPage.miniStarsDesc: First touches on the ball, coordination, and the joy of the game.
programsPage.juniorDesc: Building technical foundations — control, passing, and small-sided play.
programsPage.youthDesc: Tactical understanding, position-specific work, and competitive matches.
programsPage.advancedDesc: High-performance training for players targeting the next level.

aboutPage.title: Our philosophy
aboutPage.body1: SCORE is dedicated to developing young football players through structured training, professional coaching, teamwork, discipline, and continuous performance development. We believe every player deserves a clear development path, tracked honestly, and coaches who know them by name.
aboutPage.body2: Our programs are built around age-appropriate technical, physical, and mental development — not results at the expense of growth. Progress is measured, logged, and shared with parents after every evaluation.
